scenarios.name: DDoS Surge
scenarios.summary: A volumetric flood from unattributed sources overwhelms the primary API gateway until edge filtering absorbs it.

phases.name: Probing
phases.description: Low-rate probes map the public API surface.

phases.name: Volumetric surge
phases.description: Request volume climbs to several times the gateway's capacity. Latency rises and requests are shed.

phases.name: Edge mitigation
phases.description: Rate-based rules at the edge router drop traffic from the offending sources before it reaches the gateway.

phases.name: Attack subsides
phases.description: The flood loses intensity while filtering stays in place.

phases.name: Recovery
phases.description: Traffic returns to its normal shape and services recover.

scenarios.name: Credential Stuffing
scenarios.summary: Leaked credential pairs are replayed against the login endpoint. Almost all fail; the few that succeed are stopped by policy.

phases.name: Low and slow
phases.description: A trickle of login attempts tests which leaked credentials are still valid.

phases.name: Stuffing burst
phases.description: Login attempts surge past the identity service's capacity. Legitimate sign-ins start to fail.

phases.name: Adaptive rate limiting
phases.description: The gateway throttles login attempts per source, relieving the identity service.

phases.name: Source blocked
phases.description: The offending sources are blocked at the edge.

phases.name: Recovery
phases.description: Attempts stop and authentication returns to normal.

scenarios.name: Cedar Authorization Denial
scenarios.summary: An authenticated contractor from another tenant repeatedly attempts prohibited actions. Cedar denies every one of them.

phases.name: Permitted access
phases.description: A finance analyst reads her own tenant's ledger. Cedar permits it and the request reaches the resource.

phases.name: Prohibited export
phases.description: A contractor of another tenant requests an export of the ledger. Authentication succeeds; Cedar denies the action.

phases.name: Escalation attempts
phases.description: The principal cycles through other actions and resources. Every request is denied.

phases.name: Session revoked
phases.description: The identity service revokes the principal's sessions; requests now stop at authentication.

phases.name: Recovery
phases.description: The attempts stop.

scenarios.name: Cascading Service Failure
scenarios.summary: The primary orders database degrades. Dependent services fail, queues back up, and circuit breakers finally stop the spread.

phases.name: Latency creep
phases.description: Storage latency on the primary database climbs steadily.

phases.name: Connection exhaustion
phases.description: Slow queries exhaust connection pools. The database serves a fraction of its normal load and callers start timing out.

phases.name: Retry storm
phases.description: Callers retry failed queries, multiplying the load on an already degraded database.

phases.name: Circuit breakers open
phases.description: Callers stop sending queries and fail fast, giving the database room to recover.

phases.name: Replica promoted
phases.description: A healthy replica takes over as primary; breakers close gradually.

phases.name: Backlog drain
phases.description: Queue consumers work through the accumulated backlog.

scenarios.name: Regional Outage
scenarios.summary: An entire cloud region becomes unreachable. Health checks fail, traffic is re-routed to the failover region, and the region is later restored.

phases.name: Network partition
phases.description: Connectivity into the region degrades: packets are lost and latency spikes.

phases.name: Region dark
phases.description: Every service in the region is unreachable. Requests routed there fail.

phases.name: Failover
phases.description: The edge router withdraws the region and sends its traffic to the failover region, which absorbs the extra load.

phases.name: Region restored
phases.description: Services in the region come back with reduced capacity while caches warm up. Traffic stays on the failover region.

phases.name: Rebalancing
phases.description: Traffic shifts back to the restored region gradually.
